label: Catabolic Gutter pools (surface fishing)
note: Approximate, read from the map image. Surface exocrine. Any cycle: Kymaeros. Fass: Cryptosuctus, Ostimyr (Fass Residue bait). Hotspots show a faint green oily sheen. Fillet at Daughter in the Necralisk.
